Definition: Historical matching work provides a 2 arcsec coordinate-match construction, but no independently specified matching null/exchangeability test was recovered.
Historical workflows contain permutation/randomization concepts, but no single provenance permutation null was recovered.
Historical model validation uses held-out test data and reconstruction/leakage diagnostics; the exact controlled leakage null remains to be fixed.
Historical RandomForest control models exist, but a dedicated arithmetic-reconstruction null specification was not recovered.
Historical K test uses log-normal simulated masses with N=500, mu=9.7843, sigma=0.3645 and 100 simulations per cluster as a simulation control; independent null calibration remains required.
Historical L_cosmo work includes baseline-versus-expanded feature comparisons and alternative constructions, but no single null-preserving L_cosmo null is fixed.
Historical SFR work compares RF/GB baselines and held-out performance; exact baseline/null construction for the controlled experiment remains to be fixed.
Historical R&D includes permutation/control logic and arithmetic-feature comparisons; exact feature-label permutation procedure remains to be fixed.
Historical robustness analysis includes IQR/outlier and extreme-SFR diagnostics; exact null-preserving robustness procedure remains to be fixed.
Historical arithmetic rank calculations exist, but no fixed rank-preserving/randomized null model was recovered.
Historical morphology/redshift/arithmetic controls exist, but no fixed rank/environment null model was recovered.
Historical TDA comparisons use persistence diagrams and Wasserstein/bottleneck distances; null calibration, including the exploratory W2<0.01 threshold, remains unresolved.
Historical mapping work discusses alternative projections and degeneracy, but no fixed primary-mapping null construction was recovered.
PTD is documented as BSD-independent, but no fixed PTD null construction was recovered.
MCJ is documented as BSD-independent, but no fixed MCJ null construction was recovered.
Historical RTCH formulation requires a standard-physics recovery limit, but no fixed numerical null/control construction was recovered.
